hadiths.arabicText: فِيمَنِ انْفَلَتَتْ دَابَّتُهُ ، وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ ، أَوْ نَفَخَ أَوْ نَظَرَ فِي كِتَابٍ ، أَوْ سَلَّمَ مِنْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ سَاهِيًا
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding one whose riding animal escapes while he is in prayer, or he blows, or he looks in a book, or he gives salam after two units forgetfully

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading (bab) without any chain of transmission
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is merely a topical heading for the subsequent discussions

Topics: Chapter Heading on Prayer Irregularities

hadiths.arabicText: ، قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : فِيمَنْ صَلَّى فَانْفَلَتَتْ دَابَّتُهُ مِنْهُ , قَالَ : إِنْ كَانَتْ عن يَمِينِهِ قَرِيبًا مَشَى إِلَيْهَا قَلِيلًا ، أَوْ عن يَسَارِهِ ، أَوْ أَمَامَهُ ، فَأَرَى أَنْ يَبْنِيَ فَإِنْ تَبَاعَدَ ذَلِكَ رَأَيْتُ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ دَابَّتَهُ ، وَيَسْتَأْنِفَ الصَّلَاةَ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : فِي النَّفْخِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ , قَالَ : لَا يُعْجِبُنِي فَأَرَاهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْكَلَامِ , قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ : وَأَرَى مَنْ نَفَخَ مُتَعَمِّدًا أَوْ جَاهِلًا أَنْ يُعِيدَ صَلَاتَهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ تَكَلَّمَ مُتَعَمِّدًا ، فَإِنْ كَانَ نَاسِيًا سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ . قُلْتُ لِابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قَامَ فِي فَرِيضَةٍ أَوْ نَافِلَةٍ ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَى كِتَابٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مُلْقًى ، فَجَعَلَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِ هَلْ يُفْسِدُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاتَهُ ؟ قَالَ : إِنْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ عَامِدًا ابْتَدَأَ الصَّلَاةَ ، وَإِنْ كَانَ نَاسِيًا سَجَدَ لِسَهْوِهِ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُسَلِّمُ مَنْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ سَاهِيًا ، ثُمَّ يَلْتَفِتُ فَيَتَكَلَّمُ , قَالَ : إِنْ كَانَ شَيْئًا خَفِيفًا رَجَعَ ، فَبَنَى وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ , قَالَ : وَإِنْ كَانَ مُتَبَاعِدًا ذَلِكَ أَعَادَ الصَّلَاةَ , فَقُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ : وَمَا حَدُّ ذَلِكَ أَهُوَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ؟ قَالَ : مَا أَحُدُّ فِيهِ حَدًّا ، فَإِنْ خَرَجَ ابْتَدَأَ , وَلَكِنْ إِذَا تَبَاعَدَ ذَلِكَ ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَخْرُجْ وَأَطَالَ فِي الْقُعُودِ وَالْكَلَامِ ، وَمَا   أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ أَعَادَ وَلَمْ يَبْنِ , وَقَدْ تَكَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَاهِيًا ، وَبَنَى عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَدَخَلَ فِيمَا نَسِيَ بِتَكْبِيرٍ ، وَسَجَدَ لِلسَّهْوِ بَعْدَ السَّلَامِ . قُلْتُ لِابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ : فَإِنِ انْصَرَفَ حِينَ سَلَّمَ ، فَأَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ ، وَلَمْ يُطِلْ ذَلِكَ أَيَبْنِي أَمْ يَسْتَأْنِفُ ؟ قَالَ : هَذَا عندِي يَبْتَدِئُ . قُلْتُ : أَتَحْفَظُهُ عن مَالِكٍ ؟ قَالَ : لَا . قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ زِيَادٍ ، عن سُفْيَانَ ، عن مَنْصُورٍ ، عن إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي إِمَامٍ نَسِيَ الظُّهْرَ ، فَصَلَّى بِقَوْمٍ الظُّهْرَ ، وَهُمْ يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهَا الْعَصْرَ ؟ قَالَ : أَجْزَأَتْ عنهُ ، وَيُعِيدُونَ هُمُ    @ 1 : 135 @   الْعَصْرَ . قَالَ وَكِيعٌ ، عن سُفْيَانَ ، عن أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ ، عن سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ , قَالَ : مَا أُبَالِي نَفَخْتُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَكَلَّمْتُ . قَالَ وَكِيعٌ ، عن سُفْيَانَ ، عن الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عن أَبِي الضُّحَى ، عن /93 ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ /93 ، قَالَ : " النَّفْخُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ كَلَامٌ "$E104
hadiths.english_translation: These are juristic discussions (fiqh) by Imam Malik and Ibn al-Qasim regarding prayer issues including escaping animals, blowing in prayer, reading from a book, and mistaken salam. It includes several mawquf statements from the Tabi'een. Narrated by Ibn Abbas: 'Blowing in prayer is like speech'

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: The prayer of a man alone behind the rows

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading (bab) without any chain of transmission
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is merely a topical heading

Topics: Chapter Heading on Praying Alone Behind Rows

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : مَنْ صَلَّى خَلْفَ الصُّفُوفِ وَحْدَهُ ، فَإِنَّ صَلَاتَهُ لَيْسَتْ بِتَامَّةٍ ، فَإِنِ انْصَرَفَ وَهُوَ فِي وَقْتِهَا أَعَادَ صَلَاتَهُ . وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ : يُعِيدُ صَلَاتَهُ أَبَدًا
hadiths.english_translation: Imam Malik said: Whoever prays behind the rows alone, his prayer is not complete. If he finishes while still within the prayer time, he should repeat his prayer. Others said: He should always repeat his prayer

potential_issues.issue: This is a fiqh opinion (qawl) of Imam Malik and others, not a hadith with chain to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is a juristic ruling

Topics: Maliki Jurisprudence on Prayer Rows

hadiths.arabicText: فِي صَلَاةِ الْمَرْأَةِ بَيْنَ صُفُوفِ الرِّجَالِ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding the prayer of a woman among the rows of men

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading (bab) without any chain of transmission
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is merely a topical heading

Topics: Chapter Heading on Women Praying Among Men's Rows

hadiths.arabicText: قُلْتُ لِابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ : إِذَا صَلَّتِ الْمَرْأَةُ وَسَطَ الصَّفِّ بَيْنَ الرِّجَالِ ؟ قَالَ : لَا تُعِيدُ فِي الْوَقْتِ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَذَلِكَ خَطَأٌ أَخْطَأَتْ بِهِ . قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : إِذَا صَلَّتِ الْمَرْأَةُ بَيْنَ الرِّجَالِ ، فَقَدْ أَسَاءَتْ وَلَا إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهَا
hadiths.english_translation: Ibn al-Qasim was asked: If a woman prays in the middle of the row among men? He said: She does not repeat (the prayer) during the time nor after it, and that is an error she made. Imam Malik said: If a woman prays among men, she has done wrong but there is no repetition required of her

potential_issues.issue: This is a fiqh opinion from Malik and Ibn al-Qasim, not a hadith with chain to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is a juristic ruling

Topics: Maliki Jurisprudence on Women's Prayer Position

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : إِذَا كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِي صَلَاةِ ، فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ ، فَفَاتَتْهُ رَكْعَةٌ ، قَامَ يَقْضِيهَا ، فَجَازَ أَنْ يَقُومَ الْآخَرُ مَعَهُ يَتَطَوَّعُ بِرَكْعَةٍ ثَانِيَةٍ . قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ : وَأَرَى ذَلِكَ وَاسِعًا لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ
hadiths.english_translation: Imam Malik said: If a man is in prayer and another man comes and joins him but misses one unit, when he stands to make it up, it is permissible for the other to stand with him performing a voluntary second unit. Ibn al-Qasim said: I see this as permissible with no harm in it

potential_issues.issue: This is a fiqh opinion from Malik and Ibn al-Qasim, not a hadith with chain to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is a juristic ruling

Topics: Maliki Jurisprudence on Making Up Missed Prayer Units

hadiths.arabicText: فِي الْإِمَامِ يَتَعَايَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ ، وَفِيمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَ أَسْنَانِهِ طَعَامٌ فَابْتَلَعَهُ فِي صَلَاتِهِ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding the imam who becomes confused in prayer, and regarding one who has food between his teeth and swallows it during his prayer

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading (bab) without any chain of transmission
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is merely a topical heading

Topics: Chapter Heading on Imam Confusion and Swallowing Food in Prayer

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ : فِيمَنْ كَانَ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ ، فَوَقَفَ الْإِمَامُ فِي صَلَاتِهِ يَتَعَايَا ، فَفَتَحَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ خَلْفَهُ ، إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَا يُفْسِدُ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاتَهُ . قَالَ : وَالْفَتْحُ عَلَيْهِ وَالذِّكْرُ وَالتَّسْبِيحُ سَوَاءٌ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
hadiths.english_translation: Imam Malik said: Regarding one who is behind the imam, and the imam stops in his prayer being confused, so a man behind him prompts him - that does not invalidate his prayer. He said: Prompting him, remembrance (dhikr), and glorification (tasbih) are the same in prayer

potential_issues.issue: This is a fiqh opinion from Imam Malik, not a hadith with chain to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is a juristic ruling

Topics: Maliki Jurisprudence on Prompting the Imam

hadiths.arabicText: /11 قَالَ /22 ابْنُ وَهْبٍ /22 ، عن /94 غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ L1131 /94 ، عن /26 عُقَيْلِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ L5688 /26 ، عن /26 ابْنِ شِهَابٍ L7272 /26 ، عن /26 حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ L2542 /26 ، /27 أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ /20 " صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ يَوْمًا الصُّبْحَ ، فَقَرَأَ : /4 تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نزل الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ /4 ، فَأَسْقَطَ آيَةً , فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ : أَفِي الْمَسْجِدِ أُبَيّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ , هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ , قَالَ : فَمَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَفْتَحَ عَلَيَّ حِينَ أَسْقَطْتُ ؟ قَالَ : خَشِيتُ أَنَّهَا نسخت , قَالَ : فَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تنسخ " /27
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led the people in Fajr prayer one day and recited 'Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant.' He skipped a verse. When he finished, he said: 'Is Ubayy ibn Ka'b in the mosque?' He said: 'Yes, here I am, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'What prevented you from prompting me when I skipped?' He said: 'I feared that it had been abrogated.' He said: 'It has not been abrogated.'

hadiths.arabicText: /40 /11 قَالَ /22 ابْنُ وَهْبٍ /22 ، عن /94 طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو L4021 /94 ، عن /26 عَطَاءٍ L5625 /26 ، /27 عن /93 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 ، قَالَ : /20 " مَا الْتَفَتَ عَبْدٌ فِي صَلَاتِهِ قَطُّ إِلَّا قَالَ اللَّهُ لَهُ : أَنَا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِمَّا تَلْتَفِتُ إِلَيْهِ " /27
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: Whenever a servant turns (his gaze) in his prayer, Allah says to him: 'I am better for you than what you turn to.'

narrators.full_name: Abdullah ibn Wahb ibn Muslim al-Qurashi al-Fihri al-Misri

hadiths.arabicText: /11 قَالَ /22 ابْنُ وَهْبٍ /22 ، عن /94 ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ L7063 /94 ، عن /26 شُعْبَةَ L3797 /26 مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ : /27 صَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ /93 ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ L4883 /93 ، فَفَرْقَعْتُ أَصَابِعِي , قَالَ : فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ : /20 " لَا أُمَّ لَكَ ، تُفَرْقِعُ أَصَابِعَكَ وَأَنْتَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ " /27
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Shu'bah, the freed slave of Ibn Abbas: I prayed next to Ibn Abbas and cracked my fingers. When he finished praying, he said: 'May you have no mother! You crack your fingers while you are in prayer!'

narrators.name: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ
narrators.full_name: Abdullah ibn Wahb ibn Muslim al-Qurashi al-Fihri al-Misri

narrators.name: ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ
narrators.full_name: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Mughirah ibn Abi Dhi'b al-Amiri al-Madani

narrators.name: شُعْبَةَ
narrators.full_name: Shu'bah, mawla (freed slave) of Ibn Abbas
reliabilityIssues: Shu'bah mawla Ibn Abbas is not well-known and has limited narrations. Graded as Maqbul (acceptable when corroborated)

narrators.name: ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
narrators.full_name: Abdullah ibn Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib al-Qurashi al-Hashimi

plainChains: Ibn Wahb → Ibn Abi Dhi'b → Shu'bah (mawla of Ibn Abbas) → Ibn Abbas

potential_issues.issue: Shu'bah (mawla of Ibn Abbas) is classified as Maqbul - acceptable only when corroborated
potential_issues.impact: He is not well-established as a narrator, which slightly weakens the chain

potential_issues.issue: This is a mawquf statement (stops at the Companion Ibn Abbas), not marfu' to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: This represents Ibn Abbas's rebuke and teaching, not necessarily a direct prophetic ruling

Topics: Incident of Cracking Fingers During Prayer
Ibn Abbas's Rebuke of Improper Actions in Prayer

hadiths.arabicText: فِي الْبُنْيَانِ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْمَسْجِدِ ، وَهَلْ يُوَرَّثُ وَفِي التُّرَابِ يَكُونُ فِي الْقِبْلَةِ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding building on top of the mosque, whether it is inherited, and regarding dust that is in the direction of the qiblah

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading (bab) without any chain of transmission
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is merely a topical heading

Topics: Chapter Heading on Mosque Construction and Inheritance

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : وَسَأَلْنَا مَالِكًا عن الْمَسْجِدِ يَبْنِيهِ الرَّجُلُ ، وَيَبْنِي فَوْقَهُ بَيْتًا ، أَوْ غُرْفَةً يَسْكُنُهَا ؟ قَالَ : لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ . قَالَ : وَسَأَلْنَاهُ عن الْمَسْجِدِ يَبْنِيهِ الرَّجُلُ ، وَيَحْبِسُهُ هَلْ يُوَرَّثُ ؟ قَالَ : لَمْ أَسْمَعْ فِي ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا ، وَلَا أَدْرِي مَا هُوَ
hadiths.english_translation: We asked Malik about a mosque that a man builds, and he builds above it a house or room in which he dwells. He said: There is no harm in that. We asked him about a mosque that a man builds and makes as waqf - is it inherited? He said: I have not heard anything about that, and I do not know what it is

potential_issues.issue: This is a fiqh opinion from Imam Malik, not a hadith with chain to the Prophet ﷺ
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is a juristic ruling

Topics: Maliki Jurisprudence on Mosque Construction
Inheritance of Waqf Mosques

hadiths.arabicText: فِي التَّزْوِيقِ وَالْكِتَابِ فِي الصُّحُفِ وَالْحَجَرِ يَكُونُ فِي الْقِبْلَةِ ، وَفِي النُّقُوشِ تَكُونُ فِي الْقِبْلَةِ
hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Regarding decoration, writing on pages and stones that are in the qiblah direction, and regarding inscriptions that are in the qiblah

potential_issues.issue: This is a chapter heading (bab) without any chain of transmission
potential_issues.impact: Cannot be graded as a hadith - it is merely a topical heading

Topics: Chapter Heading on Mosque Decoration and Qiblah Direction
